name: rtp
description: Put peaq machines to paid work on the Robot Task Protocol (RTP) using the Spraay x402 gateway. Handles the provider side (register a robot with its capabilities, pricing, payment address and webhook connection; serve dispatched tasks; report completion to release escrow) and the buyer side (discover robots, dispatch a paid task over x402, poll the task lifecycle, read a robot profile). Also handles fleet payouts via Batch Payments for Agents (BPA) 1.0 — pay up to 200 robot operators in one atomic, non-custodial transaction on Base, with a free schema pre-flight and a live fee quote before anything is signed. Payment is USDC over x402 on Base (eip155:8453) or Solana. A machine's peaqID address doubles as its RTP payment address, so a peaq-onboarded machine can start earning without a second identity.

runtime_dependency.notes: The free RTP endpoints (register, complete, update, deregister) need nothing but curl. The paid endpoints need an x402 client that speaks x402Version 2 — the gateway's own 402 challenge declares version 2, so use @x402/fetch + @x402/evm (v2). The older `x402-fetch` package implements v1 and is deprecated. There is no peaqos CLI command for RTP; this skill drives the gateway over HTTP.
